title: Generalized cross-entropy as a noise-robust weak-to-strong loss
description: Treat weak labels as noisy labels and train with generalized cross-entropy, (1 - p_y^q) / q, which sits between cross-entropy and mean absolute error. Unlike cross-entropy, it puts little gradient on examples the model finds very unlikely, so the student stops chasing labels that contradict its pretrained representation. Prediction: fewer copied weak errors and higher performance gap recovered than plain fine-tuning.

source.title: Generalized cross entropy loss for training deep neural networks with noisy labels
